body.text: Dinosaur Museum Established in 1993, the Dinosaur Museum has developed into the largest display of dinosaur and prehistoric life in Canada. Hours 9 a.m. — 5 p.m. (Mon. — Fri.) / 9 a.m. — 3 p.m. (Sat. & Sun.) Admission $4 for adults, $2 for students & children Programs Paint a Dinosaur Egg! At 10 a.m. every day, kids can paint a dinosaur egg to take home. Dinosaur Quiz At 2 p.m. during the weekend, one winner of our dinosaur quiz will be given a real fossil as a prize. Guided Tours The tours run at 11 a.m. and 1 p.m. every day. The tours are free and require no bookings. Just show up! Notice Food and pets are prohibited in the museum. Please do not touch or climb on the exhibits.
